items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: So I had taken the -- all the records I'd made with Mezzrow Jelly and Bence Roet, Eddie Condon, Jack Bland, Red Allen, and I put them on one album.

ctx.x: Danny Logan, trombone player. And so one night he said, well, let's go down to the little old E flat joint -- that means a little old raggedy place -- said, fellow down there, he sings and drums. So he tell us -- he came out of Youngstown, Ohio. Well, right across Ohio and Pennsylvania right into one states together like Pennsylvania and New York, upstate New York. They went down there, and Tiny was on these drums, singing and jumping up and down on the drums, bouncing.
So about two years afterwards he came to New York, and he was up there working with -- Red Allen was in the band with this boy, with the piano player, used to feature Stardust for a theme song.
